title: Ordinary root-line pullback squares and strict-system laws
statement: With the canonical Tate laws [def-pur-canonical-tate-naturality-laws], retain the base-change compositor of a commuting scheme square and its uniquely double-adjunction-unit-normalized ordinary module pullback comparison. Transport these maps to single complexes and the specified ordinary total tensor; retain the corresponding image/strict geometric law predicates and the actual compatible roots-of-unity inverse-system law. Every comparison and normalization is the existing one [def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists], [def-pur-canonical-tate-comparisons].

source.place: Canonical root-arrow spatial, tensor and coefficient comparisons and their strict systems; existing naturality constructors relocated for compilation.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary direct-image square from the base-change compositor on the pro-etale site and the coefficient-composition equation. Conjugate it through the two composite module adjunctions. The abstract unit equation gives the displayed double-unit section formula; evaluation and the adjunction homEquiv prove uniqueness. Map the existing line and square comparisons to degree-zero complexes and total tensor and retain the strict-system and root-tower equation definitions. All existing private helpers and public constructors are relocated unchanged.

proof_origin.place: E9: existing constructors and proved helpers are relocated without statement or data changes after local canonical instance priorities and opacity reduced compilation cost but delivery preflight still took 62 seconds for the original consumer.

theorem ordinarySquare_existsUnique {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (w : X ⟶ Y)
    (g : Y ⟶ Y) (g' : X ⟶ X) (h : g' ≫ w = w ≫ g) :
    ∃! e : modulePull l E g ⋙ modulePull l E w ≅ modulePull l E w ⋙ modulePull l E g',
      ∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) (V : Y.ProEt) (x : M.val.obj (op V)),
        (e.hom.app M).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange w).obj
            ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V)))
          (moduleSection l E w ((modulePull l E g).obj M)
            ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V) (moduleSection l E g M V x)) =
        ((modulePull l E g').obj ((modulePull l E w).obj M)).val.map
          ((siteSquare w g g' h).hom.app V).op
          (moduleSection l E g' ((modulePull l E w).obj M)
            ((proEtaleBaseChange w).obj V) (moduleSection l E w M V x))
